meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后，当你提出找论文的需求，Claude 会调用学术搜索工具，在 arXiv、PubMed、IEEE 等平台按关键词、作者或主题检索，并返回相关文献结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“搜索论文”“查找学术论文”“搜索 arXiv”等涉及文献检索的请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下最近的 arXiv 预印本，主题是强化学习。
在 PubMed 上查找关于糖尿病的临床试验论文。
say.note: Claude 会调用 PubMed 搜索工具返回相关文献。

say.text: 搜索 IEEE Xplore 里关于 transformer 的论文。
say.note: Claude 会调用 IEEE 平台搜索对应内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask for papers, Claude will use academic search tools to query platforms like arXiv, PubMed, IEEE, etc., by keyword, author, or topic, and return relevant results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to "search for papers", "find academic papers", "search arXiv", or similar literature-search requests.

say_en.text: Search recent arXiv preprints on reinforcement learning.
say_en.note: Claude will call the arXiv search tool to retrieve related preprints.

say_en.text: Find clinical trial papers on diabetes in PubMed.
say_en.note: Claude will use PubMed search to return relevant literature.

say_en.text: Look up transformer papers on IEEE Xplore.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke the IEEE platform search.
